title: When the Semester Wakes
author: Edmund Joubert
blurb: Casper Okafor, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, has spent three years being so careful it hurts. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship before the final audition.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
